The query has a **critical error** in SQL syntax. The WHERE clause is placed before GROUP BY, but COUNT(o.id) is an aggregate function that can only be used in a HAVING clause (after GROUP BY). The correct syntax should be:

```sql
SELECT c.name 
FROM customers c 
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id 
GROUP BY c.name 
HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 5;
```
